function[T0] { forall(x0: (T0, T0) -> Bool, x1: T0, x2: T0) { not lib(relation).is_asymmetric[T0](x0) or not (x0(x1, x2) and x0(x2, x1)) } }
function[T0] { forall(x0: T0 -> Bool) { not exists(k0: T0) { not x0(k0) } or not forall(x1: T0) { x0(x1) } } }
function[T0] { forall(x0: Set[T0], x1: T0, x2: T0) { x2 ∈ x0.insert(x1) = x2 ∈ x0 or x1 = x2 } }
function[T0, T1] { forall(x0: T0 -> T1, x1: T0 -> T1) { not lib(function).is_injective_fn[T0, T1](x0) or x0 != x1 or lib(function).is_injective_fn[T0, T1](x1) } }

function[T0, T1] { forall(x0: T0 -> T1, x1: (T1, T1) -> Bool, x2: (T1, T1) -> Bool, x3: T0, x4: T0) { lib(relation).relation_union[T0, T0](lib(order).relation_pullback[T0, T1](x0, x1), lib(order).relation_pullback[T0, T1](x0, x2), x3, x4) = lib(order).relation_pullback[T0, T1](x0, lib(relation).relation_union[T1, T1](x1, x2), x3, x4) } }

function[T0: TopologicalSpace] { forall(x0: Set[T0], x1: Set[lib(analysis.topology.topological_space).Subspace[T0, x0]]) { exists(k0: Set[T0]) { lib(analysis.topology.topological_space).has_subspace_witness[T0](x0, x1, k0) } = lib(analysis.topology.topological_space).subspace_open[T0](x0, x1) } }

function[T0: TopologicalSpace] { forall(x0: Set[T0], x1: Set[lib(analysis.topology.topological_space).Subspace[T0, x0]]) { not exists(k0: Set[T0]) { lib(analysis.topology.topological_space).has_subspace_witness[T0](x0, x1, k0) } or lib(analysis.topology.topological_space).subspace_open[T0](x0, x1) } }
function[T0] { forall(x0: Set[T0], x1: T0, x2: Set[T0]) { (x1 ∈ x0 and not x1 ∈ x2) = x1 ∈ x0 ∖ x2 } }

function[T0, T1] { forall(x0: T0 -> T1, x1: T0 -> T0, x2: T1 -> T1, x3: (T1, T1) -> Bool) { not lib(order).preserves_unary_op[T0, T1](x0, x1, x2) or not lib(function).is_surjective_fn[T0, T1](x0) or lib(order).is_unary_congruence[T0](lib(order).relation_pullback[T0, T1](x0, x3), x1) = lib(order).is_unary_congruence[T1](x3, x2) } }

function[T0, T1] { forall(x0: (T0, T0) -> Bool, x1: T0 -> T0, x2: T1 -> T0, x3: T1 -> T1) { not lib(order).is_unary_congruence[T0](x0, x1) or not lib(order).preserves_unary_op[T1, T0](x2, x3, x1) or not lib(function).is_surjective_fn[T1, T0](x2) or lib(order).is_unary_congruence[T1](lib(order).relation_pullback[T1, T0](x2, x0), x3) } }
